Specification: This module specifies a bounded producer-consumer buffer with a shared wait set, translated from a PlusCal algorithm. Producers in P append the string "d" to the sequence buffer when the buffer length is below capacity K, and consumers in C remove the last element when the buffer is nonempty; otherwise processes add themselves to waitset. The temporal specification is Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars, and it also defines a Termination property requiring eventual arrival at a state where every process has pc[self] = "Done", although the translated actions keep processes at "lbp" or "lbc" and include a stuttering disjunct for a hypothetical Done state. The file also includes an invariant Inv == waitset # ProcSet, a view projection, and a large PostCondition value that encodes a TLC-generated counterexample trace and action metadata.
IfThenElse: IF Len(buffer) >= K THEN /\ waitset' = (waitset \cup {self}) /\ pc' = [pc EXCEPT ![self] = "lbp"] /\ UNCHANGED buffer ELSE /\ buffer' = Append(buffer, "d") /\ IF waitset # {} THEN /\ \E x \in waitset: waitset' = waitset \ {x} ELSE /\ TRUE /\ UNCHANGED waitset /\ pc' = [pc EXCEPT ![self] = "lbp"]
IF waitset # {} THEN /\ \E x \in waitset: waitset' = waitset \ {x} ELSE /\ TRUE /\ UNCHANGED waitset

IF Len(buffer) = 0 THEN /\ waitset' = (waitset \cup {self}) /\ pc' = [pc EXCEPT ![self] = "lbc"] /\ UNCHANGED buffer ELSE /\ buffer' = RemoveLast(buffer) /\ IF waitset # {} THEN /\ \E x \in waitset: waitset' = waitset \ {x} ELSE /\ TRUE /\ UNCHANGED waitset /\ pc' = [pc EXCEPT ![self] = "lbc"]
IF waitset # {} THEN /\ \E x \in waitset: waitset' = waitset \ {x} ELSE /\ TRUE /\ UNCHANGED waitset
